G-Labs Disclaimer

Disclaimer

DISCLAIMER
Any and all liability for risks resulting from investment transactions or other asset dispositions carried out by the customer based on information received or a market analysis is expressly excluded by G-Labs or Apex Pro Group Ltd. All the information made available here is generally provided to serve as an example only, without obligation and without specific recommendations for action. It does not constitute and cannot replace investment advice. We therefore recommend that you contact your personal financial advisor before carrying out specific transactions and investments.

In view of the high risks, you should only carry out such transactions if you understand the nature of the contracts (and contractual relationships) you are entering into and if you are able to fully assess the extent of your risk potential. Trading with futures, options, forex, CFDs, stocks, cryptocurrencies and similar financial instruments is not suitable for many people. You should carefully consider whether trading is appropriate for you based on your experience, your objectives, your financial situation and other relevant circumstances.
Past performance gives no indication of future results.
We wish to point out to you some specific risks below that may result from trading with financial instruments.
RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH ELECTRONIC TRADING
Before you begin carrying out transactions with an electronic system, you should carefully review the rules and provisions of the stock exchange offering the system, or of the financial instruments listed that you intend to trade, as well as your broker’s conditions. Online trading has inherent risks due to system responses/reaction times and access times that may vary due to market conditions, system performance and other factors, and on which you have no influence. You should be aware of these additional risks in electronic trading before you carry out investment transactions.
RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH THE STOCK MARKET
All opinions, news, investigations, analyses, prices or other information or statements offered by G-Labs or Apex Pro Group Ltd are provided in the form of general remarks and comments. They do not constitute investment advice.  G-Labs or Apex Pro Group Ltd assumes no liability for loss or damage, including, but not limited to, lost profits that may result directly or indirectly from the use or reliance on the abovementioned opinions, news, investigations, analyses, prices or other information offered by the company. In this regard we also refer to our General Business Terms and Conditions.
All the investment forms described here involve large financial risk. The past performance of a security, an industry, a sector, a market, a financial product, a trading strategy or the individual trade does not guarantee any future results or returns. As an investor, you yourself bear the full responsibility for your individual investment decisions. Such decisions should be based on an assessment of your financial situation, your investment objectives, your risk tolerance and your liquidity needs and should be discussed in advance with your personal financial advisor in case of doubt.
RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH FUTURES TRADING
Futures transactions involve high risk. The amount of the initial margin is low compared to the value of the futures contract, so that transactions are “leveraged” or “geared”. A relatively small market movement has a proportionately larger impact on the funds that you have deposited or have to pay: this can work both for you and against you. You may experience the total loss of the initial margin funds as well as any additional funds deposited in the system. If the market develops in a way that is contrary to your position or if margins are increased, you may be asked to pay significant additional funds at short notice to maintain your position. In this case it may also happen that your broker account is in the red and you thus have to make payments beyond the initial investment.

RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH FOREX TRADING
Trading in foreign exchange (“Forex”) on margins entails high risk and is not suitable for all investors. Past performance is not an indication of future results. In this case, as well, the high degree of leverage can act both against you and for you. Before you decide to invest in foreign exchange, you should carefully assess your investment objectives, experience, financial possibilities and willingness to take risks. There is a possibility that you will lose your initial investment partially or completely. Therefore, you should not invest any funds that you cannot afford to completely lose in a worst-case scenario. You should also be aware of all the risks associated with foreign exchange trading and contact an independent financial advisor in case of doubt.
Leverage enables traders, using a relatively small amount of money, to take a position that is many times the initial investment. This leverage effect can work both in your favour and to your detriment. The Forex market opens up the possibility to utilize this leverage effect to a high degree; at the same time, however, it also opens up the risk of experiencing high losses. Please trade with caution when you use leverage in trading or investing. Your risk is particularly not limited to the initial investment, but can quickly fall into a negative range in the event of strong movements, meaning you may be obligated to pay far more than your initial wager.
RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH OPTIONS TRADING
Trading in options involves considerable risk and is not a suitable form of investment for all investors. The risk in options trading that you will lose your entire investment within a relatively short period of time is comparatively high. It is possible that the loss and the resulting payment obligation will be higher than the funds invested through your securities account. Therefore, please be sure to check in advance on your trading broker’s terms and conditions of those of the custodian bank. Before you decide to invest in the options market, you should carefully consider your investment objectives, experience, financial resources and willingness to take risks. There is a possibility that you will experience a significant loss that can quickly exceed your initial investment.
In this case, as well, past performance gives no indication of future results.

In view of the above, there can thus be no guarantee or promise given for the success or profitability of investments made. By using this website, you expressly acknowledge and agree that Tradeciety cannot be held liable for any and all damage resulting from investments made. Furthermore, we refer to our General Business Terms and Conditions.
None of the information made available by G-Labs or Apex Pro Group Ltd constitutes an invitation to trade in financial instruments or securities of any kind.
We wish to point out that trading in stocks, currencies, CFDs (Contracts for Difference), Forex, spread betting, futures and cryptocurrencies, etc. (“Trading”) involves a significant risk of loss and is not suitable for all investors; in particular, past developments do not necessarily indicate future results. Please note that the risk of loss in trading can be substantial. You should therefore find out the details of your financial situation and, if necessary, consult professional help to assess whether your personal and financial situation allows trading and whether you are in a position to take the high risk of loss. If a broker, a commercial adviser or you yourself create contingent orders, such as a “stop loss” or “stop limit” order, such will not necessarily limit your losses to the intended amounts; market conditions may make such limits impossible.
Furthermore, we would like to draw attention to the “leverage” effect of trading, which can work both for you and against you. Exploiting such leverage effects can lead to large losses in trading on the one hand and to high profits on the other.
The trading and developments shown in this tutorial are based solely on simulated and hypothetical transactions, which naturally limits the possibilities of their visualization. Unlike the result shown in a real current account, these results do not constitute real trade. As the transactions depicted here have not actually been carried out, the results may be over- or undercompensated in terms of certain market factors, such as a lack of liquidity. Furthermore, the videos are designed from a retrospective point of view and serve solely to provide introduction and orientation. Consequently, it is not possible to specify whether a development will repeat in the future, in the same or a similar way.
The information disclosed here is for entertainment purposes only; it does not constitute investment advice. It cannot replace professional investment advice.
G-Labs or Apex Pro Group Ltd cannot be held responsible for possible losses or other damage. Consequently, no claims for damages can be asserted. Please also note that trading has a certain addictive potential. If you find yourself at risk, please seek professional help.
We urge you to take responsibility for obtaining advice regarding property law and to be informed professionally about all the risks and possibilities of trading. Before you make an investment decision, please contact your financial adviser.

The testimonials shown on this website explicitly refer to the individual experiences of individual users, which do not allow conclusions to be drawn about other, future situations and may represent exceptional cases. The testimonials are neither representative nor do they exempt you from the requirement to consult a qualified financial advisor before making investments.

TRADING TOOLS

We continually update our products to ensure we offer you the best products available in the market.

COMMUNITY

In our discord community collaborate with like minded traders and grow as a team .

EDUCATION

Learn from our daily analysis videos, our weekly educational webinars and our flashcard content .

Development

We work everyday to build new tools and make improvements to our existing tools after listening to customer feedback

DATA PRIVACY

We keep your data and information cure and do not share it with third parties.

24/7 SUPPORT

We are here to support you in every step
and will work with you to resolve any problem.

TRADING TOOLS

We continually update our products to ensure we offer you the best products available in the market.

COMMUNITY

In our discord community collaborate with like minded traders and grow as a team .

EDUCATION

Learn from our daily analysis videos, our weekly educational webinars and our flashcard content .

Development

We work everyday to build new tools and make improvements to our existing tools after listening to customer feedback

DATA PRIVACY

We keep your data and information cure and do not share it with third parties.

24/7 SUPPORT

We are here to support you in every step
and will work with you to resolve any problem.

G-Labs Connix Smart Trading For TradingView

The unfair edge you have been looking for !

ACCESSIBLE FROM ANY DEVICE TECHNICAL ANALYSIS AUTOMATED TRADING SIMPLIFIED PRO TRADING TOOLS TRADING COMMUNITY

Sign Up Now!

Introduce

Meet Garry

CEO g-labs

Garry lives in London in the UK where G-Labs is based. Garry has been trading and developing software since 2014 and has faced the struggles you may be facing today.  Garry has tried almost every strategy and faced just about every issue you could in trading. Be it in strategy psychology or in risk management. Garry has settled on two key areas of focus smart money concepts and beating the market maker.  Garry has developed a fantastic range of tools to allow you to trade these two winning strategies with ease and efficiency. Our trade manager product allows you to calculate your risk correctly and manage your trades perfectly. At G-Labs Garry is continually updating the range of products to ensure the greatest efficiency in trading.

G-Labs Connix Smart Trading For TradingView

The unfair edge you have been looking for !

https://g-labs.software/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/WhatsApp-Video-2022-10-05-at-1.03.27-AM.webm

Features of product

Real-Time Smart Money Concepts Analysis Single Asset Panel Or Multi Asset Dashboard packages available

    • Market Structure Markers
    • Order Blocks
    • Breaks In Market Structure
    • Volume Candles
    • Multi Timeframe
    • Average Daily Range
    • Daily Range
    • Strong Highs And Lows
    • CHoCH – Change Of Character
    • Imbalances/FVG
    • Dashboard For Current Asset
    • Market Scanner For Selected Pairs
    • Trading Session Range Boxes
    • Equal High And Low finder
    • Trading Ranges
    • Premium and Discount Prices
    • History Order Blocks
    • Alerts Sent To Your Mobile App- BOS Alerts, Imbalance Touch Alerts, Retest of Order Block Alerts.
    • Any Asset On TradingView

Frequently Asked Question

Where can I find BTMM template installer?

Click here to download BTMM template installer.

Where can I find tutorial of Trade Manager by G-Labs?

Click here to see tutorial.

How to Master G-Labs Dashboard?

Click here to see tutorial.

How to G-Labs IC Breaker Order Blocks indicator?

Click here to see video on set up and how to use indicator.

Are you facing issues in setting up Tradingview?

Click here to see video on set up and how to use Tradingview.

I want to learn Market Maker Dashboard Strategy?

Click here to see video on the strategy of market maker dashboard.

I am facing issues on Market Maker Dashboard?

Click here to see video on common problems of market maker dashboard.

Where to find Garry's MQL5 products?

Visit here to see garry's mql5 products.

What are the benefits of G-Labs Trade Manager?

Auto calculates % risk per trade Manual lot size input $ Risk amount Displays profit to loss ratio Shows value of stop loss and take profit in pips and dollars Shows Balance equity and open profit and loss .

Why G-Labs' Dashboard is the Go-To Choice for Traders?

Advanced Market Maker Cycle Tracking: Get ahead with a tool that offers deep insights into market maker cycles, a feature that sets it apart in the trading software market. Cyber Monday Exclusive Price: Benefit from our special $40 deal, making it a highly affordable and smart investment for both new and experienced traders. User-Focused Design and Performance: Enhanced based on trader feedback, the dashboard excels in cycle direction, stop hunt alerts, and ADR tracking accuracy.

What are the hot keys for G Labs Trade Manager?

S for Sell, Buy
E for Execute

What are Order blocks and how to trade with the Indicator?

Order Blocks are levels used by institutions for buying and selling in the market. They show us a shift in market structure, trend continuation and trend reversal Source order blocks- shown on chart as rectangle (Continuation of trend until LSB - Last step broken) Breaker Blocks shift in market structure - shown on chart as solid rectangle (LSB) Trend Reversal.

How to renew membership?

To renew your membership visit g-labs.software after every 30 days to order your selected plan or upgrade your plan. If you want to buy yearly or two year membership contact us on info@g-labs.software.

item.content:encoded:
Advanced Financial Analytics & Educational Technology

Empowering UK SMEs and individuals with institutional-grade market data analysis, risk management protocols, and quantitative modeling tools

PROFESSIONAL ANALYTICS SUITE CROSS-PLATFORM CLOUD ARCHITECTURE COLLABORATIVE RESEARCH NETWORK AUTOMATED MARKET STRUCTURE MODELING

Explore Analytics Suite

View Software Licence Options

Complex Data Simplified

Next-Generation Analytics Infrastructure

  • Quantitative Market Analysis.

  • Algorithmic Probability Modeling

  • Institutional Data Visualization

  • Cloud-Based Research Tools

  • Professional Risk Protocols

About Garry

Founder & Lead Developer

CEO, G-Labs Software

Our Services

TRADING MADE SIMPLE

ANALYTICS SUITE

We continually update our algorithms to ensure the most precise data modeling available.

RESEARCH NETWORK

Collaborate with other analysts and share market structure data in our dedicated server

KNOWLEDGE BASE

Access our library of technical documentation, webinars, and statistical case studies

R&D INNOVATION

Continuously developing new visualization engines for the TradingView platform

DATA PRIVACY

We keep your data and information Secure and do not share it with third parties.

24/7 SUPPORT

We are here to support you in every step
and will work with you to resolve any problem.

What Our Customers Says!

Darren Barber Darren Barber ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

G-Labs provides a level of market structure visibility that is rare in retail software. The data visualization tools have completely transformed how I analyze probability

Jacqueline Allen Jacqueline Allen ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

The educational resources and risk management protocols are exceptional. This is not just a tool, but a comprehensive system for disciplined financial analysis

Stephen O Brien Stephen O Brien ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

I appreciate the focus on statistical probability over speculation. The software is robust, stable, and integrates perfectly into my daily workflow

5 Month Ago

Our Journey!

November 2020Core Algorithm Development

Initial deployment of our proprietary market structure analysis engine

August 2021Risk Protocol Module

Release of the automated position sizing and exposure management system.

September 2022Cloud Analytics Integration

Expansion to cloud-based visualization tools for cross-platform compatibility

September 2022Institutional Data Engine

Launch of advanced cycle detection algorithms for professional researchers

Elevate Your Market Analysis with

G-Labs Software

item.content:encoded:
Advanced Financial Analytics & Educational Technology

Empowering UK SMEs and individuals with institutional-grade market data analysis, risk management protocols, and quantitative modeling tools

PROFESSIONAL ANALYTICS SUITE CROSS-PLATFORM CLOUD ARCHITECTURE COLLABORATIVE RESEARCH NETWORK AUTOMATED MARKET STRUCTURE MODELING

Explore Analytics Suite

View Software Licence Options

Complex Data Simplified

Next-Generation Analytics Infrastructure

  • Quantitative Market Analysis.

  • Algorithmic Probability Modeling

  • Institutional Data Visualization

  • Cloud-Based Research Tools

  • Professional Risk Protocols

About Garry

Founder & Lead Developer

CEO, G-Labs Software

Our Services

TRADING MADE SIMPLE

ANALYTICS SUITE

We continually update our algorithms to ensure the most precise data modeling available.

RESEARCH NETWORK

Collaborate with other analysts and share market structure data in our dedicated server

KNOWLEDGE BASE

Access our library of technical documentation, webinars, and statistical case studies

R&D INNOVATION

Continuously developing new visualization engines for the TradingView platform

DATA PRIVACY

We keep your data and information Secure and do not share it with third parties.

24/7 SUPPORT

We are here to support you in every step
and will work with you to resolve any problem.

What Our Customers Says!

Darren Barber Darren Barber ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

G-Labs provides a level of market structure visibility that is rare in retail software. The data visualization tools have completely transformed how I analyze probability

Jacqueline Allen Jacqueline Allen ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

The educational resources and risk management protocols are exceptional. This is not just a tool, but a comprehensive system for disciplined financial analysis

Stephen O Brien Stephen O Brien ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

I appreciate the focus on statistical probability over speculation. The software is robust, stable, and integrates perfectly into my daily workflow

5 Month Ago

Our Journey!

November 2020Core Algorithm Development

Initial deployment of our proprietary market structure analysis engine

August 2021Risk Protocol Module

Release of the automated position sizing and exposure management system.

September 2022Cloud Analytics Integration

Expansion to cloud-based visualization tools for cross-platform compatibility

September 2022Institutional Data Engine

Launch of advanced cycle detection algorithms for professional researchers

Elevate Your Market Analysis with

G-Labs Software

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Introduce

Garry Goodchild

Founder & Lead Systems Architect

With a background in algorithmic systems design and quantitative market analysis, Garry founded G-Labs to bridge the technological divide in the financial research sector. His focus lies in developing accessible, high-performance data visualization tools that empower users to understand complex market structures without the need for institutional-grade infrastructure

Empowering Financial Research Through Technology

Sub-Headline: Bridging the gap between institutional data analysis and independent research.

Our Mission: At G-Labs, we are dedicated to democratizing access to high-level financial data analysis. Our mission is to provide independent researchers, students, and analysts with the same grade of quantitative tools used by institutional firms, fostering a more transparent and accessible financial research ecosystem.

Our Technology: We specialize in developing algorithmic market structure scanners and cross-asset data visualization modules. Our proprietary software engines process real-time market data to identify statistical anomalies, liquidity cycles, and structural pivots, allowing users to make data-driven decisions based on quantitative evidence rather than speculation.

Who We Serve:

- Independent Researchers: Validating market theories with institutional-grade data.
- Educational Institutions: Providing students with real-world analytical platforms.
- Financial Analysts: Streamlining workflow with automated structure detection

With a background in algorithmic systems design and quantitative market analysis, Garry founded G-Labs to bridge the technological divide in the financial research sector. His focus lies in developing accessible, high-performance data visualization tools that empower users to understand complex market structures without the need for institutional-grade infrastructure<\/p>

Empowering Financial Research Through Technology<\/p>

Sub-Headline: Bridging the gap between institutional data analysis and independent research.<\/p>

Our Mission: At G-Labs, we are dedicated to democratizing access to high-level financial data analysis. Our mission is to provide independent researchers, students, and analysts with the same grade of quantitative tools used by institutional firms, fostering a more transparent and accessible financial research ecosystem.<\/p>

Our Technology: We specialize in developing algorithmic market structure scanners and cross-asset data visualization modules. Our proprietary software engines process real-time market data to identify statistical anomalies, liquidity cycles, and structural pivots, allowing users to make data-driven decisions based on quantitative evidence rather than speculation.<\/p>

Who We Serve:<\/p>

- Independent Researchers: Validating market theories with institutional-grade data.
- Educational Institutions: Providing students with real-world analytical platforms.

PORTFOLIO

G-LABS PART OF APEX PRO GROUP

The unfair edge you have been looking for !

Our Products Solve Trading Problems

The platform of the future

RESULTS ARE GOING HERE LATER

Our Services

WE SIMPLIFY TRADING

SOFTWARE

We provide the industry leading tools to help you succeed as a trader .Our Market scanner and Trade manager are our two market leading products.

COMMUNITY

We have an active community on discord where we all help each other as a community.

EDUCATION

Learn from professional developers how to use our software correctly and how to trade our strategies. We offer daily webinars and courses online

Development

We don't rest. We are always working to improve our tools and the services we deliver.

DATA PRIVACY

ensuring that any data transferred between users and websites, or between two systems, remains impossible to read

24/7 SUPPORT

We are here to support you in every step
and will work with you to resolve any problem.

item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
This is a sample page.

Overview

Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can’t offer you a full refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.

Additional non-returnable items:

  • Gift cards
  • Downloadable software products
  • Some health and personal care items

To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:

  • Book with obvious signs of use
  • CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.
  • Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.
  • Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.

Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.

Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.

If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at {email address}.

Sale items

Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at {email address} and send your item to: {physical address}.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.

Shipping returns

To return your product, you should mail your product to: {physical address}.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.

If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need help?

Contact us at {email} for questions related to refunds and returns.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
TRADE MANAGER BY G-LABS

The unfair edge you have been looking for !

TRADING SIMPLIFIED PRO TRADING TOOLS 24/7 SUPPORT MARKET ANALYSIS TRADING COMMUNITY MORE SECURE

7 Day Free Trial With £1 Sign Up Fee

Introduce

Meet Garry

CEO g-labs

Garry lives in London in the UK where G-Labs is based. Garry has been trading and developing software since 2014 and has faced the struggles you may be facing today.  Garry has tried almost every strategy and faced just about every issue you could in trading. Be it in strategy psychology or in risk management. Garry has settled on two key areas of focus smart money concepts and beating the market maker.  Garry has developed a fantastic range of tools to allow you to trade these two winning strategies with ease and efficiency. Our trade manager product allows you to calculate your risk correctly and manage your trades perfectly. At G-Labs Garry is continually updating the range of products to ensure the greatest efficiency in trading.

G-Labs Trade Manager

The unfair edge you have been looking for !

Features of product

The Most Advanced MT4 Trade Manager. With 1-Click Execution, Risk Calculation, Manage Multiple Trades From One Chart. And Many Other Powerful Features To Make Your Trading Much More Efficient.

  • Calculates Risk – Calculate Risk Either By % Or By $ Risk.
  • Manages Your Trades – Options to Take Partial Profits, Move Stoploss to Break Even
  • Trade Entry Lines – Draggable Lines On Chart To Place Entry Take Profit And Stoploss
  • Daily Profit Target – Set Auto Close All trades When % Profit Target Met.
  • Max Daily Drawdown – Set To Close All Trades When % Drawdown Is Reached
  • Close All Trades On Change Of Trend Direction
  • Close All trades Button
  • Close All Trades In Profit Button
  • Hide Stoploss And Take Profit From Broker
  • Trailing Stop Via Pips Or Moving Average
  • Allows You To Manage Multiple Trades From One Chart
  • Shows You Trend Direction
  • Allows Market Orders And Pending Orders
  • Advanced Limit Orders With Pattern Recognition
  • Trading Statistics – Shows You Key Data About Your Trading Results
  • Symbol Changer Allows You To View Any Pair From One Chart
  • Shows Risk To Reward Ratio And Monetary And Pip Value of Stoploss And Take Profit
  • All Useful Trade Information In One Easy To Read Panel That Can Be Minimized Or Moved To Any Position On Your Chart.

G-Labs Trade Manager

Manage Your Trades Perfectly

Special Offer 7 Day Free Trial With £1 Sign Up Fee

Our Product Rating

BUY NOW / START TRIAL

item.content:encoded:
G-Labs Connix Smart Trading For TradingView

The unfair edge you have been looking for !

ACCESSIBLE FROM ANY DEVICE TECHNICAL ANALYSIS AUTOMATED TRADING SIMPLIFIED PRO TRADING TOOLS TRADING COMMUNITY

Sign Up Now!

Introduce

Meet Garry

CEO g-labs

Garry lives in London in the UK where G-Labs is based. Garry has been trading and developing software since 2014 and has faced the struggles you may be facing today.  Garry has tried almost every strategy and faced just about every issue you could in trading. Be it in strategy psychology or in risk management. Garry has settled on two key areas of focus smart money concepts and beating the market maker.  Garry has developed a fantastic range of tools to allow you to trade these two winning strategies with ease and efficiency. Our trade manager product allows you to calculate your risk correctly and manage your trades perfectly. At G-Labs Garry is continually updating the range of products to ensure the greatest efficiency in trading.

G-Labs Connix Smart Trading For TradingView

The unfair edge you have been looking for !

https://g-labs.software/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/WhatsApp-Video-2022-10-05-at-1.03.27-AM.webm

Features of product

Real-Time Smart Money Concepts Analysis Single Asset Panel Or Multi Asset Dashboard packages available

    • Market Structure Markers
    • Order Blocks
    • Breaks In Market Structure
    • Volume Candles
    • Multi Timeframe
    • Average Daily Range
    • Daily Range
    • Strong Highs And Lows
    • CHoCH – Change Of Character
    • Imbalances/FVG
    • Dashboard For Current Asset
    • Market Scanner For Selected Pairs
    • Trading Session Range Boxes
    • Equal High And Low finder
    • Trading Ranges
    • Premium and Discount Prices
    • History Order Blocks
    • Alerts Sent To Your Mobile App- BOS Alerts, Imbalance Touch Alerts, Retest of Order Block Alerts.
    • Any Asset On TradingView

G-Labs Connix Smart Trading For TradingView

Smart Money Concepts For Smart Traders

Our Product Rating

Summer Sale Hurry up!

Sign Up Now!

What Our Customers Says!

Darren Barber Darren Barber ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

You guys truly have a real gift for looking at the market and seeing it for it really is and helping others also see the same information in one easy to read platform. this product as helped my trading no end!

Jacqueline Allen Jacqueline Allen ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

I’ve been a fan of you guys for some time and this tool and the accompanying videos have really helped me understand how to get the best out of the dashboard and profit from my trading. Since using the dashboard my trading has improved greatly

Stephen O Brien Stephen O Brien ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

Thanks to Garry and Chris., my trading is going allot better now and I am able now to not spend so much time stuck in front of the charts. I am able to do my analysis fast now and trade with confidence

5 Month Ago joninbc joninbc ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

Yes it is. I've never traded with as much confidence.It seems to be what I needed. I know it's only been one day, But I can see like never before on the charts.

5 Month Ago

Start trading like a pro

G-Labs

CEO g-labs

Garry has been trading and developing software since 2014 and has faced the struggles you may be facing today.  Garry has tried almost every strategy and faced just about every issue you could in trading. Be it in strategy psychology or in risk management. Garry has settled on two key areas of focus smart money concepts and beating the market maker.  Garry has developed a fantastic range of tools to allow you to trade these two winning strategies with ease and efficiency. Our trade manager product allows you to calculate your risk correctly and manage your trades perfectly. At G-Labs Garry is continually updating the range of products to ensure the greatest efficiency in trading.

CONNIX SMART TRADING MT4 BY G-LABS

The unfair edge you have been looking for !

TRADING SIMPLIFIED PRO TRADING TOOLS 24/7 SUPPORT MARKET ANALYSIS TRADING COMMUNITY MORE SECURE

7 Day Free Trial With £1 Sign Up Fee

Introduce

Meet Garry

CEO g-labs

Garry lives in London in the UK where G-Labs is based. Garry has been trading and developing software since 2014 and has faced the struggles you may be facing today.  Garry has tried almost every strategy and faced just about every issue you could in trading. Be it in strategy psychology or in risk management. Garry has settled on two key areas of focus smart money concepts and beating the market maker.  Garry has developed a fantastic range of tools to allow you to trade these two winning strategies with ease and efficiency. Our trade manager product allows you to calculate your risk correctly and manage your trades perfectly. At G-Labs Garry is continually updating the range of products to ensure the greatest efficiency in trading.

G-Labs Trade Manager

The unfair edge you have been looking for !

Features of product

 Real-Time Smart Money Concepts Analysis Available On MT4
  • Order Blocks 
  • Breaks In Market Structure 
  • Strong Highs And Lows 
  • Imbalances
  • Multiple Time-Frames Available On One Chart 
  • History Order Blocks 
  • Trading Ranges – Premium And Discounted Prices 
  • Alerts Push To Mobile Device And Pop UP 
  • Alert Scanner Dashboard Coming Soon

CONNIX SMART TRADING MT4

Smart Money Concepts For Smart Traders

Special Offer 7 Day Free Trial With £1 Sign Up Fee

Our Product Rating

BUY NOW / START TRIAL

What Our Customers Says!

Smart Money Signal BY G-LABS

The unfair edge you have been looking for !

TRADING SIMPLIFIED PRO TRADING TOOLS 24/7 SUPPORT MARKET ANALYSIS TRADING COMMUNITY MORE SECURE

7 Day Free Trial With £1 Sign Up Fee

Introduce

Meet Garry

CEO g-labs

Garry lives in London in the UK where G-Labs is based. Garry has been trading and developing software since 2014 and has faced the struggles you may be facing today.  Garry has tried almost every strategy and faced just about every issue you could in trading. Be it in strategy psychology or in risk management. Garry has settled on two key areas of focus smart money concepts and beating the market maker.  Garry has developed a fantastic range of tools to allow you to trade these two winning strategies with ease and efficiency. Our trade manager product allows you to calculate your risk correctly and manage your trades perfectly. At G-Labs Garry is continually updating the range of products to ensure the greatest efficiency in trading.

item.title: Connix Cross-Market Data Suite
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Connix Cross-Market Data Suite

The Connix Cross-Market Data Suite expands the capabilities of our logic engine to handle diverse datasets simultaneously. It is engineered for analysts who need to understand the relationship between different market sectors.

Core Capabilities:

- Simultaneous Data Stream Processing: Analyzes up to 8 different financial instruments concurrently to identify leading and lagging relationships.
- Correlation Matrix: Visualizes how volatility in one asset class (e.g., Commodities) impacts price action in another (e.g., Currencies).
- Macro-Trend Verification: Uses data from multiple sectors to confirm the strength and validity of a broader economic trend.
Technical Specifications:

- High-Throughput Computation: Optimized to handle heavy data loads without latency.
- Inter-Market Logic: Algorithms designed specifically to detect flow of funds between different asset classes.
This tool is vital for constructing a holistic view of the global financial landscape
item.excerpt:encoded: The Connix Cross-Market Data Suite expands the capabilities of our logic engine to handle diverse datasets simultaneously. It is engineered for analysts who need to understand the relationship between different market sectors.

item.title: Connix Analytical Module (Single Asset)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Connix Analytical Module (Single Asset)

The Connix Analytical Module (Single Asset) offers the same powerful logic as our full suite but is streamlined for analysts who specialize in specific markets.

Core Capabilities:

- Focused Data Processing: Dedicates computational resources to a single data feed for maximum precision and speed.
- Asset-Specific Calibration: Allows users to fine-tune the algorithm's sensitivity to match the specific volatility profile of a chosen instrument (e.g., Gold, S&P 500, or specific Forex pairs).
- Detailed Trend Validation: Provides granular insight into the micro-structure of price movements for your primary asset of interest.
Ideal For:

- Specialized analysts focusing on a specific sector or commodity.
- Researchers requiring high-fidelity data validation for a single market variable.
This module ensures you have the depth of analysis required for your specific area of expertise
item.excerpt:encoded: The Connix Analytical Module (Single Asset) offers the same powerful logic as our full suite but is streamlined for analysts who specialize in specific markets.

item.title: Connix Quantitative Analysis Suite
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Connix Quantitative Analysis Suite
Description: "The Connix Quantitative Analysis Suite is our flagship logic engine. It moves beyond simple charting to provide a computed, evidence-based view of market behavior.
Core Capabilities:
- Predictive Trend Modeling: Utilizes weighted probability algorithms to forecast likely price trajectories based on historical data. - Institutional Flow Visualization: Highlights hidden order flow and liquidity gaps that traditional indicators miss. - Confluence Validation: Cross-references multiple data points (volume, volatility, time) to confirm statistical significance. Technical Specifications:
- Native TradingView Integration: Optimized for the TradingView platform, ensuring real-time responsiveness and data integrity. - Adaptive Logic: The software 'learns' from current volatility conditions to filter out false positives and market noise. This suite provides the robust analytical framework needed for professional-grade market research.
item.excerpt:encoded: The Connix Quantitative Analysis Suite is our flagship logic engine. It moves beyond simple charting to provide a computed, evidence-based view of market behavior.

item.title: Algorithmic Market Structure Scanner
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The Algorithmic Market Structure Scanner is designed to streamline the research process by automating the search for high-probability market conditions. It filters through market noise to identify significant structural alignments.

Core Capabilities:

- Automated Data Screening: Continuously monitors real-time data feeds to highlight assets meeting specific structural criteria, reducing manual analysis time.
- Cyclic Pattern Recognition: Visualizes recurring data loops and volatility cycles to forecast potential market turning points.
- Statistical Confluence Detection: Identifies moments where multiple analytical models align, suggesting a statistically significant market event.
Technical Specifications:

- Real-Time Alerts: Provides instant notifications when specific data conditions are met.
- Customizable Parameters: Allows users to define their own scanning criteria based on volatility, volume, and time-based structures.
This tool empowers analysts to cover more ground and identify key opportunities without being glued to the screen
item.excerpt:encoded: The Algorithmic Market Structure Scanner is designed to streamline the research process by automating the search for high-probability market conditions. It filters through market noise to identify significant structural alignments.

item.title: Title: Algorithmic Market Structure System
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Understanding market structure is critical for any financial analyst. The Algorithmic Market Structure System is designed to visualize the 'invisible hand' of institutional order flow across multiple asset classes.

Core Capabilities:

- Liquidity Density Mapping: Automatically highlights areas of significant historical volume, indicating potential support and resistance zones.
- Multi-Asset Compatibility: Seamlessly analyzes data across Equities, Forex, and Commodities markets using a single unified interface.
- Institutional Footprint Tracking: Identifies statistical anomalies that suggest large-scale institutional participation.
Technical Specifications:

- Real-Time Data Processing: Processes live tick data to generate instant structure updates.
- Adaptive Volatility Bands: Dynamically adjusts to changing market conditions to reduce noise and false signals.
This tool is an essential component for any quantitative research desk or independent analyst seeking a deeper understanding of market mechanics
item.excerpt:encoded: Understanding market structure is critical for any financial analyst. The Algorithmic Market Structure System is designed to visualize the 'invisible hand' of institutional order flow across multiple asset classes

item.title: Institutional Cycle Explorer
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The Institutional Cycle Explorer is a sophisticated data visualization suite designed for serious market analysts. By aggregating real-time market data, this tool identifies statistical anomalies and cyclical patterns that are often invisible to the naked eye.
Package Inclusions:
- Multi-Asset Liquidity Analysis System: (Formerly 'Smart Money Concepts') Advanced tracking of institutional volume flow and liquidity density across diverse asset classes. - Algorithmic Market Structure System: (Formerly 'Market Maker System') Visualizes the underlying mathematical framework of market movements, highlighting high-probability mean reversion points. - Full Analytical Suite Access: Includes comprehensive access to our complete library of proprietary data visualization indicators. Key Technical Features:
- Algorithmic Structure Detection: Automatically plots key statistical pivot points based on historical volatility and volume profiles. - Cycle Analysis: Visualizes market rhythm and flow using proprietary algorithms, allowing users to align their analysis with macro-market movements. - Data-Driven Insights: Removes emotional bias from decision-making by providing objective, math-based market readings. Ideal for financial researchers and quantitative analysts looking to deepen their understanding of market microstructure
item.excerpt:encoded: The Institutional Cycle Explorer is a sophisticated data visualization suite designed for serious market analysts. By aggregating real-time market data, this tool identifies statistical anomalies and cyclical patterns that are often invisible to the naked eye

I also wanted to focus on and cater for a wider audience and hence why I am now focussed on developing the best tools for the two most powerful trading strategies in the world. 

I will still be supplying existing and new clients with the time tested MT4 software which will be available through Apex Pro Group links can be found in the product page of G-Labs. 

With the recent events in the Russian war we are seeing Major economies ditching support for Russian based companies. Which we have seen in the past 2 weeks in the USA and now people are looking for an alternative. 

This is where G-Labs is ready with the two solutions you need

All premium packages supplied by G-Labs  come with both trading systems and all other premium custom indicators we have for TradingView including TDI Double top Double Bottom finder. With future tools continually in development.

item.title: FAQs
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Frequently Asked Question

What is the Institutional Cycle Explorer?

The Institutional Cycle Explorer is our premier data visualization tool. It tracks algorithmic market cycles and identifies statistical pivot points using real-time data feeds, helping analysts understand market structure without relying on subjective interpretation.

How do I access the educational video library?

All active subscribers receive access to our comprehensive video library. These tutorials cover platform setup, data interpretation, and advanced risk management protocols. You can find them in your Member Dashboard under "Educational Resources.

Do you offer software for risk management

Yes. Our "Risk Management Console" is designed to help users calculate position sizing, exposure limits, and statistical probabilities. It emphasizes disciplined data analysis over speculative decision-making.

Can I use G-Labs software on any device?

Our web-based dashboards are accessible from any browser. For specific desktop applications (like our advanced charting tools), we provide installation guides for Windows and Mac environments.

Are you facing issues in setting up Tradingview?

Click here to see video on set up and how to use Tradingview.

How do I renew my subscription?

Subscriptions can be managed directly through the "My Account" section. You can choose monthly or annual plans depending on your research needs. For institutional or multi-user licenses, please contact our support team.

Is this software suitable for beginners?

Yes. G-Labs is an "Educational Technology" platform first. We provide the tools and training to take a user from novice to competent analyst. However, we always recommend users start with our "Foundations of Market Analysis" video series.

What happens if I need technical support?

We offer dedicated email support for all users. If you encounter setup issues or need clarification on a tool's function, simply submit a ticket via the "Contact Us" page.

item.title: Terms & Conditions
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Terms & Conditions

1. Introduction
Welcome to G-Labs Software. These Terms and Conditions govern your use of the G-Labs software and analytics services. By accessing or using our software, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

2. Subscription Term and Renewal
a. The minimum subscription term for G-Labs software is one month. Your subscription will automatically renew each month unless you cancel it.
b. You are responsible for canceling your subscription if you no longer wish to use the software. Cancellations can be done through the customer portal on our website.

3. No Refund Policy
a. G-Labs operates with a strict no-refund policy. Once you have subscribed to our software, we do not offer refunds for any reason, including partial months.
b. We encourage our customers to thoroughly evaluate the software during their subscription period to ensure it meets their needs.

4. Use of Software
a. As a subscriber, you are granted a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the G-Labs software for your personal or business research and analysis.
b. You agree not to use the software for any illegal purpose or in any manner inconsistent with these Terms and Conditions.

5. Technology Usage & Data Limitations
a. You acknowledge that G-Labs software is a tool for market data analysis, visualization, and educational research.
b. The software provides statistical models and historical data analysis. Past performance of any model, indicator, or signal is not indicative of future market behavior.
c. G-Labs does not offer investment advice, and any content within the software should not be construed as such. G-Labs will not accept liability for any loss or damage which may arise directly or indirectly from the use of or reliance on such information.
d. You are solely responsible for your interpretation of the data and any research outcomes derived from the software. You acknowledge that all analytical outcomes are probabilistic in nature.

6. Cancellation
a. You may cancel your subscription at any time via the customer portal. The cancellation will be effective at the end of your current billing cycle.
b. You are responsible for ensuring your cancellation is processed correctly. G-Labs is not responsible for any issues arising from a failure to properly cancel your subscription.

7. Modifications to Terms and Conditions
G-Labs reserves the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Your continued use of the software after any such changes constitutes your acceptance of the new Terms and Conditions.

Advanced Financial Analytics & Educational Technology

Empowering UK SMEs and individuals with institutional-grade market data analysis, risk management protocols, and quantitative modeling tools

PROFESSIONAL ANALYTICS SUITE CROSS-PLATFORM CLOUD ARCHITECTURE COLLABORATIVE RESEARCH NETWORK AUTOMATED MARKET STRUCTURE MODELING

Explore Analytics Suite

View Software Licence Options

Complex Data Simplified

Next-Generation Analytics Infrastructure

  • Quantitative Market Analysis.

  • Algorithmic Probability Modeling

  • Institutional Data Visualization

  • Cloud-Based Research Tools

  • Professional Risk Protocols

About Garry

Founder & Lead Developer

CEO, G-Labs Software

Our Services

TRADING MADE SIMPLE

ANALYTICS SUITE

We continually update our algorithms to ensure the most precise data modeling available.

RESEARCH NETWORK

Collaborate with other analysts and share market structure data in our dedicated server

KNOWLEDGE BASE

Access our library of technical documentation, webinars, and statistical case studies

R&D INNOVATION

Continuously developing new visualization engines for the TradingView platform

DATA PRIVACY

We keep your data and information Secure and do not share it with third parties.

24/7 SUPPORT

We are here to support you in every step
and will work with you to resolve any problem.

What Our Customers Says!

Darren Barber Darren Barber ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

G-Labs provides a level of market structure visibility that is rare in retail software. The data visualization tools have completely transformed how I analyze probability

Jacqueline Allen Jacqueline Allen ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

The educational resources and risk management protocols are exceptional. This is not just a tool, but a comprehensive system for disciplined financial analysis

Stephen O Brien Stephen O Brien ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆

I appreciate the focus on statistical probability over speculation. The software is robust, stable, and integrates perfectly into my daily workflow

5 Month Ago

Our Journey!

November 2020Core Algorithm Development

Initial deployment of our proprietary market structure analysis engine

August 2021Risk Protocol Module

Release of the automated position sizing and exposure management system.

September 2022Cloud Analytics Integration

Expansion to cloud-based visualization tools for cross-platform compatibility

September 2022Institutional Data Engine

Launch of advanced cycle detection algorithms for professional researchers

Elevate Your Market Analysis with

G-Labs Software
